issues.explanation: 「ところ」itself means “place” or “point”; “when” is the contextual meaning of the 「たところ」 construction.
「あそこ」means “over there” or “that place.” “That part” is a context-specific paraphrase rather than the individual word’s meaning.
「評する」means to evaluate, appraise, or critique; “comment” is too vague for this segment.
